text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. I received an ornamental mini cactus
from an acquaintance, but...
choice_data_list: Hmm, where should I display this?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Just put that crap by the window.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I heard it wards off evil spirits or something.
If you put it by a window, that is."
choice_data_list: Huh~! You sure know some interesting things.
Huh~! You sure know some interesting things.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch, not like I believe in it myself!
Some noisy jerk was just telling me about it, alright?!
choice_data_list: Who did you hear that from?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...My roommate talks about feng shui all the time,
so I ended up learning it whether I wanted to or not."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“—Look forward to working with you from today, Espo-san!
Not to waste any time, but...
can I give you a liiittle bit of advice?”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Facing south enhances your 'popularity luck' and 'beauty'☆
So I recommend decorating with bright colors
and gorgeous ornaments~♪"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: And then, and then! If you store metallic accessories in the west or northwest, which carry the metal element, it creates great synergy~...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, shut up already!
Stop whining about everything I do!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Tch! What's with that guy?
Bossing me around to do this and that from day one..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are, Espo-san~!
There was something I forgot to give you earlier!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: What the heck is this?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Inside is a lavender-scented hand cream☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "In feng shui, pleasant scents draw in good luck~♪ And lavender has the power to ward off evil spirits, too☆"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, ridiculous.
Feng shui is basically just glorified superstition.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's not it, Espo-san! Feng shui is
ancient wisdom for putting yourself in optimal condition!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's easy to fall out of rhythm in a new environment, right?
That's exactly when Feng Shui comes in handy! Take care of yourself,
and you'll draw in good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Like I care... Do whatever the hell you want.
Why're you draggin' me into it?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because, because, we finally got to be
roommates together!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want you to have the best run possible with the power of Feng Shui too, Espo-san~!
I thought it'd be great if we could elevate each other like that~!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
…………Tch.
Seriously, so annoying.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Geez, talking about 'feng shui' and
'bringing out the best in each other'...
Saying all that with a straight face...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Still... look at her eyes...
Even though everyone's laughing at her, she doesn't flinch one bit...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
......Dammit.
Just how straightforward can you be...?

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
—That shop got more cacti in stock again~
—Putting them by the window wards off evil spirits, right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (Ward off evil spirits, huh... Come to think of it, she said that hand cream she gave me does something like that too...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
…………Tch.
Taking hits lying down just ain't my style…….

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Espo-san!
...Huh? What's in that bag...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Here. You put it up.
It'd be annoying if they started nagging about the layout again.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~, it's a cactus~~!
Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Totally Happy☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You know, according to feng shui, cacti have the power to ward off evil spirits from outside! That's why it's great to put them outside your entryway or by a window~♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hmph... I already know that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That look... Could it be
you've taken an interest in feng shui?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
!! D-Don't get the wrong idea!
Buying that was totally a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I just found it by chance, and thought it looked spiky and cool!
...T-That's all it is, got it?!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "I still don't really get feng shui or whatever. But before I knew it, I started caring which way my cactus was facing."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, it's all that guy's fault.
I ended up picking up all this useless knowledge.
choice_data_list: ...You two have a great roommate dynamic.
...You two have a great roommate dynamic.
I'd love to hear more about feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, it's all that guy's fault.
I ended up picking up all this useless knowledge.
choice_data_list: ...You two have a great roommate dynamic.
...You two have a great roommate dynamic.
I'd love to hear more about feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah?
I'm totally normal, totally!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wipe that smirk off your face!
Cut it out!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san, look, look!
I bought this ceramic pot for double potting~♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ceramics carry the Earth element, which boosts a plant's vitality. The pot's cream color is also well-balanced according to Feng Shui.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. In that case, hurry up and get ready.
You're gonna put them into the cactus pots, right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who bought the cactus anyway.
I'll get it done in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks, Espo-san!
I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Don't ask me.
Look it up yourself.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. About feng shui...
Is there anything simple I could try incorporating?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wah! It's so rare for Espo-san to
ask about feng shui~♪
What is it? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's totally nothing!
This is, well... just casual chitchat, okay!?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'll listen to your feng shui talk, alright?!
S-So say something, dammit!
